categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haishun New Pharmaceutical Packaging Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical packaging materials industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of high-barrier packaging materials. The company also extends its business into new energy and new consumer sectors, providing packaging solutions for pharmaceuticals, lithium batteries, and consumer electronics. Its product portfolio includes soft packaging materials like cold-formed composite sheets and PTP aluminum foil, as well as hard packaging materials such as PVC/PVDC composite sheets and precision injection molded components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies including composite cold forming, multi-layer co-extrusion, precision coating, and precision injection molding. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as dry and hot adhesive bonding for aluminum-plastic films and utilizes ERP systems for production planning and quality control. The firm emphasizes R&D in recyclable composite materials, functional membrane materials, and aluminum-plastic films, supported by a robust patent portfolio and collaboration with academic institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international pharmaceutical companies such as Qilu Pharmaceutical, Yunnan Baiyao, Shanghai Pharmaceuticals, Guangyao Group, Huahai Pharmaceutical, Federal Pharmaceutical, and AstraZeneca. The company serves pharmaceutical manufacturers producing tablets, capsules, granules, powders, and suppositories. Additionally, it caters to the lithium battery industry and consumer electronics sectors, expanding its market reach beyond pharmaceuticals.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and multiple subsidiaries across Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Hebei, and other provinces. It has established an international presence through its wholly-owned subsidiary Haishun Europe GmbH in Berlin and actively participates in global trade shows in countries including South Korea, Japan, Italy, and Egypt. Its overseas markets cover Southeast Asia, the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East, with growing penetration in emerging markets and gradual expansion into developed markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Haishun operates mainly in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical packaging supply chain, manufacturing high-performance packaging materials. It sources raw materials such as aluminum foil, adhesives, PVC, nylon, and PET from upstream suppliers and delivers finished packaging products to downstream pharmaceutical manufacturers and battery producers. The company also extends upstream by producing base film materials for packaging enterprises, indicating some vertical integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained R&D investment focused on recyclable composite materials, high-barrier functional membranes, and aluminum-plastic films. It aims to develop new products with enhanced barrier properties, corrosion resistance, and environmental sustainability. Strategic R&D projects include anti-counterfeiting cold-formed aluminum composite sheets, high-barrier liquid packaging films, ultra-high moisture barrier blister sheets, and high-strength aluminum-plastic films. The firm also emphasizes digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and green development aligned with global sustainability trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of pharmaceutical packaging materials, including soft and hard packaging products. The company employs a sales model dominated by direct sales to pharmaceutical manufacturers and supplemented by distributor sales for trade customers. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies related to its operations. The firm’s revenue is derived from product sales contracts recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Haishun is positioned as a leading domestic pharmaceutical packaging materials provider with a strong brand and technical innovation capabilities. It competes in a fragmented market with many small and medium enterprises, focusing on high-end, high-barrier packaging solutions to differentiate itself. The company holds numerous drug packaging registration numbers and DMF filings, and maintains partnerships with top pharmaceutical companies, reinforcing its competitive edge in quality, technology, and service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, representing an 11.92% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 74.59 million, a decrease of 12.7% year-over-year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 2.89 billion with a net asset value of RMB 1.74 billion. It has shown steady revenue growth with expanding overseas sales, which grew by 24.38% in 2024, and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Haishun emphasizes high-performance, safe, and sustainable pharmaceutical packaging solutions that ensure drug quality and patient safety. Its products feature advanced barrier properties, anti-counterfeiting technologies, and environmental friendliness such as recyclable and degradable materials. The company’s integrated service from R&D to end-user packaging, combined with strong quality control and compliance with international standards, provides differentiated value to pharmaceutical and new energy customers, enhancing product reliability and regulatory compliance.
